text:
Ana: quick thought — proposing a co-fund structure for marketplace listings to accelerate trial-to-paid conversion. idea is partner + us subsidize first 6 months while they hit a minimum usage floor. :thinking_face:
Bharat: sounds promising. how do you see the economics? is this a flat rebate or a committed rebate that steps down on renewal?
Ana: steps-down. example: 40% subsidy month 0–3, 20% month 4–6, then renewal at list price with a renewal bonus credit if they exceed the usage floor. keeps churn down.
Lena: can we sketch a simple discount matrix for sellers and SI partners? easier to share with sales. i can make a one-pager.
Matt: margin flag — 40% sounds aggressive. need per-SKU floors and an internal floor so we don't lose money on big LTV variance.
Alli: legal check — any co-fund wording needs to be clear about who owns the customer list and data access. also need audit clauses for claimed usage.
Sam: pilot idea: pick 3 partners across cloud vendors (1 infra partner, 1 SI, 1 marketplace-native ISV). small scale, 90-day pilot, track conversion and net dollar retention.
Ana: agreed. pilot metrics: activation rate, $/MAU, renewal conversion, and lift vs control cohort. will link doc: https://tinyurl.com/mp-cofund-plan
Jules: add a channel discount matrix snippet to the doc. quick mock below — can we align on bands?
MarketplaceBot: new doc created by Lena: "Co-Fund Pilot — Discount Matrix" (https://tinyurl.com/mp-cofund-plan)
Lena: mock matrix (very rough):
```
Band A: usage >= 250k tokens/mo -> co-fund 35% (3 months), renewal credit $15k
Band B: 100k–249k -> co-fund 25% (3 months), renewal credit $6k
Band C: 25k–99k -> co-fund 15% (3 months), conversion credit $2k
```
Jules: also thinking of a "volume floor" clause: partner must maintain 70% of average usage in month 4–6 to retain renewal credit.
Matt: add an internal eligibility gate: customer LTV expected > 12x subsidy amount or stop. i can run quick backtests on historical deals.
Alli: countersigned SOW template needed + audit right + termination on misuse. i'll draft legal bullets.
Bharat: how do we handle cloud vendor promos stacked on top? e.g., marketplace credits plus our co-fund. need an exclusion or a stacking cap.
Ana: propose stacking cap: total subsidies (vendor + us) <= 50% of list for pilot. helps manage risk.
Sam: operationally, billing needs a simple flow: 1) partner reports usage weekly, 2) we invoice partner subsidy monthly net of customer refunds, 3) automatic application of renewal credit as a one-time line item. can we automate via marketplace APIs?
Lena: yep, we'll map API hooks per vendor. i'll add an implementation checklist in the doc.
Jules: timing — want pilot kickoff in 6 weeks. sales and partner eng alignment needed.
Ana: okay i'll assemble stakeholder runbook and action items. volunteers for pilot ops? @Sam @Bharat @Lena @Alli?
Sam: in. happy to own partner onboarding and metrics.
Bharat: i'll handle partner economics and deal desk approvals.
Lena: design + docs, on it.
Alli: legal review timeline: 2 weeks.
Ana: great. next steps: finalize matrix w/ Matt's margin sanity checks, post final doc, and schedule vendor partner sync. :rocket:
Matt: will have margin checks by EOD Tue.
Ana: thanks everyone.
